title: Heading to the Nikkei Shinshun Hai

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
the featured race of this week is
—the Nikkei Shinshun Hai!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
With Rose Kingdom and Rulership,
both talk of the Classic circuit,
entering the fray,
the highest-caliber lineup in the race's
history has gathered here today.

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
What a star-studded lineup,
hardly what you'd expect for a GⅡ!
Moreover,
this marks Rose Kingdom's comeback race
after bypassing the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
With the settling of their storied rivalry
on the line,
this is definitely a race to look forward
to~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
496, 497—keep your hips low!
Focus on your form! 498, 499, last one!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*Gasp*... *wheeze*... *huff*... *pant*!
You truly show no mercy, as always...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool. Even I know my limits. Still,
for you to step forward and volunteer for
a showdown of fate—
I suppose the Twinkle Series has helped you
grow.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Under normal circumstances perhaps,
but if that is the case,
do not lose.
My mother's dignity is at stake.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I never move a piece expecting defeat.
...Setting aside all that talk of schools
and the like.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...She is a master strategist.
She will undoubtedly bring
a multitude of tactics into the Nikkei
Shinshun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To prevail, I must hone my own weapons.
Cultivating stamina, and unleashing
a burst of speed down the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us redouble our efforts.
And...
let us ensure this race is one without a
single regret.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days leading up to the Nikkei Shinshun
Hai flew by in a flash—and then.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Rose-san,
could we get a look over here, please!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Together with my Trainer, I have
duly received Rulership's message.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If I have been granted the chance to avenge
that past defeat,
I could ask for nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Speak of the devil, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, everyone gathered here.
Quite an impressive number of cameras for
a GⅡ race, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Could we trouble you for one more comment
regarding your declaration of war for this
fateful grudge match?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: A grudge match, huh—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, that was mere bait.
I have little interest in grudges or fated
rivalries.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Uh, um, what do you mean by that?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Rose sitting out the Arima Kinen was a
heavy
blow.
In essence—it was like missing the chance
to see one of a grandmaster's cards.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A lack of information leads to defeat.
It places us at a distinct disadvantage as
we head into the second half.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to drag Her Majesty
onto this stage, no matter what it took.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Not a heartbroken girl,
but her at her absolute best, that is.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Kind as you are,
you probably took my declaration of war
as an act of mercy—
and trained yourself diligently day after
day.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
So the groundwork is laid to perfection,
then.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
It seems I, too,
had grown far too accustomed to lukewarm
waters.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I had forgotten your true nature.
You played me brilliantly.
Thanks to that,
power is surging through me to the brim.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If that is what you desire,
then I shall crush you utterly and
completely.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Naturally,
you are prepared for what is to come.
Are you not, Rulership?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now that's what I like to hear.
I'll return those exact words right back to
you,
Rose Kingdom...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
let's get the Nikkei Shinshun Hai
underway!
